Hero.title: Preserving Eastern Congo Languages Through AI
Hero.description: KivuLingua is building open speech and language datasets for underrepresented Bantu languages to enable inclusive AI, linguistic preservation, and community-driven research across Eastern Congo.

community.description: Native Mashi speakers and contributors already involved in community validation and linguistic preservation.

languages.description: Underrepresented Bantu languages from Eastern Congo targeted for preservation and AI research.

audio.description: High-quality aligned speech recordings planned for ASR and TTS dataset construction.

open.description: Community-owned datasets and benchmarks designed for open African language AI research.

Research.title: Advancing Language Science Through Research
Research.description: Our research initiatives focus on developing methodologies and tools for low-resource language AI. We collaborate with linguistic communities and academic institutions to produce peer-reviewed research and open-source contributions to the field.

Community.title: Empowering Communities Through Collaboration
Community.description: Language preservation begins with community. We work directly with native speakers, linguistic experts, and local organizations to ensure our work respects cultural contexts and creates lasting impact.

Roadmap.title: Our Journey to Language Preservation
Roadmap.description: We're building this project incrementally with community input. Each phase builds upon previous achievements while expanding our reach across more languages and regions.
